name: block-unapproved-egress
description: Best-effort guard on the tool channel: blocks sending data to a host outside the allowlist (.chock/egress-allowlist.txt, else a built-in registry list): curl/wget/iwr uploads, nc/socat/telnet, scp/rsync/sftp, ssh commands, aws/gsutil/az uploads, git push|remote add URLs, $(..)/$VAR in a URL or host. Asks on interpreter HTTP one-liners, gh gist/--body-file, curl --proxy/--resolve/Host:. Blocks ~/.curlrc writes. A floor, not a sandbox: other clients, runtimes, obfuscation. [Session-enforced in Cursor by a beforeShellExecution hook: a matched command is denied before it runs (witnessed blocking on Cursor, 2026-08-24). The hook needs git, a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py; the Windows Store stub is skipped) and a usable bash resolved from PATH. The hook entry sets `failClosed`, which Cursor's hooks documentation (cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks) says blocks the action when the hook fails to run, so a hook that cannot start refuses the command. If the guard itself crashes, the hook returns `permission: "ask"`, which beforeShellExecution honours. Repo-wide enforcement at commit time and in CI still needs `chock sync`.]
